summary_md: **Gaël Caporale ([@Gael_DDOS](https://x.com/Gael_DDOS/status/2116498101779550680))** points to NVIDIA's Apache-2.0 **spark-local-inference** server for SM120/SM121 hardware (DGX Spark and workstations): Ignition builds graphs and Helios serves from Rust, with recipes for Qwen NVFP4 on one Spark, GLM across four and DeepSeek V4.1 on four; no benchmarks yet ([NVIDIA/local-inference](https://github.com/NVIDIA/local-inference)).
relevance: Official NVIDIA inference stack for DGX Spark.
